about_the_game:
About This Game

Galactic Pit Stop Simulator is a cooperative management game that puts you in charge of a fuel station in deep space. Manage your market, oversee your hangar for trading, and refuel incoming ships while keeping your station running smoothly. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op, and work together to build the ultimate interstellar pit stop.

Key Features

Space Station Management
Run your own interstellar fuel station, balancing resources, trade, and customer needs.

Market & Hangar Trading
Stock your market, manage your hangar, and trade goods with travelers from across the galaxy.

Refuel Incoming Ships
Handle docking requests, manage fuel supplies, and keep traffic moving smoothly.

Upgrade & Expand
Improve your station with better technology, bigger hangars, and more profitable markets.

Solo or Online Co-op
Play alone or team up with up to three friends to run the ultimate galactic pit stop together.

Dynamic Challenges
Adapt to unexpected events, demanding customers, and the chaos of space traffic.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 || AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 TI || Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
